input: My commute is 50 minutes each way by bus. A car would cut it to 25 but I would take on a loan and parking costs. I work from home two days a week.
reworded_input: Bus commute is 50 minutes door to door; driving would halve it to 25. But that means a loan plus parking. I'm remote two days a week.
notes: Weekly hours saved are derivable from the stated figures; costs are not.
